title: We spent the last year building a platform where anyone can create and play living game worlds
author: ImportantAd4397
selftext:
Hi everyone,

About a year ago, we started asking ourselves a simple question:

**What if creating a game world didn't require learning an entire game engine?**

Most creator tools today are great at generating assets, code, or dialogue.

What we wanted was something different, a place where people could create an actual playable world.

After many months of building, rebuilding, and throwing away ideas that didn't work, we finally have something we're excited to share.

The current version lets creators:

* Build a game world with a consistent visual style
* Create characters with their own personalities, memories, and goals
* Design quests and storylines without scripting every interaction
* Jump into the world and play immediately
* Publish worlds for other people to explore

One thing we're especially proud of is that the world doesn't stop once it's created.

Characters continue interacting with each other.

Relationships change.

Events happen.

Stories emerge naturally as the world evolves instead of following one fixed path.

It's still very much an early version, and we're learning something new every week from people trying it.

I'd genuinely love to hear what this community thinks.

If you were building a platform like this, what's the first thing you'd want to experiment with?

If you'd like to follow the project or try an early build, we've just opened a small batch of early access invites:

**👉** [**https://play.elseland.ai/**](https://play.elseland.ai/)

I'd love to answer any questions about the workflow, world simulation, or the technical challenges we've run into while building it.
